english.note: Use this when emphasizing that most of the items, people, time, or amount are involved.
Use this when mostly refers to the greater part of a group, amount, or set of people or things.

examples.english: The audience was principally made up of students.
examples.traditional: 現場大部分觀眾都係學生。
examples.jyutping: jin6 coeng4 daai6 bou6 fan6 gun1 zung3 dou1 hai6 hok6 saang1

examples.english: These students mostly live in Kowloon.
examples.traditional: 呢班學生大部分都住喺九龍。
examples.jyutping: nei1 baan1 hok6 saang1 daai6 bou6 fan6 dou1 zyu6 hai2 gau2 lung4
